Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-rays (particularly Figure 3) demonstrate linear streaks of radiolucency (dark lines) paralleling the mediastinal structures and outlining the pulmonary arteries/hila, which is the classic "ring around the artery" sign or continuous diaphragm sign indicative of pneumomediastinum. Option A describes pneumothorax, while C, D, E, and F describe findings inconsistent with the lucent air collections seen in the images.
